ap.ignore_policy: Unmatched detections overlapping any Misc box at the class IoU threshold are ignored for all target classes
ap.range_policy: GT and prediction centers independently filtered; lower inclusive, upper exclusive

extended.density_note: Full-domain matching first; recall stratified by fixed128 and actual GT point counts. Inclusive box faces. Shared spatial crop before voxel caps.
extended.calibration_note: Equal-width ECE/Brier on nonignored post-NMS detections; no score recalibration. No detections means undefined ECE/Brier; missed objects represented by recall, not ECE.

source_calibration.method: median elevation per ring per scan, then median across training scans
